description:
List recent mailings (sent emails). Example: { "prospect_id": "123" } or { "limit": 10 }

Returns sent emails with subject, status (delivered/bounced/opened), and timestamps.

page_offset.description: Record offset into the result list for pagination (maps to the API's page[offset]; e.g. 25 for the second page with limit 25)

prospect_id.description: Filter mailings for a specific prospect

name: outreach_list_mailings
